title: Merge K Sorted Linked Lists
description: You are given an array of `k` linked-lists, each linked-list is sorted in ascending order. Merge all the linked-lists into one sorted linked-list and return its values.
input_format: First line contains `k`. Following `k` lines contain integer `len` followed by `len` integers.
output_format: Space-separated values of the merged list.
hints: Use a min-heap to keep track of the current smallest node among all k lists.
Extract min node, add to result, and insert its next node into the heap.
Time complexity is O(N log k) where N is the total number of nodes.

reference_solution:
import sys
lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
all_vals = []
if lines:
    k = int(lines[0].split()[0])
    for line in lines[1:1+k]:
        parts = line.split()
        if parts:
            cnt = int(parts[0])
            all_vals.extend([int(x) for x in parts[1:1+cnt]])
all_vals.sort()
print(' '.join(map(str, all_vals)))
